Beta. Back up your files before you try it, and please report what breaks.

## What was broken in beta 1

Beta 1 installed fine, but most people never saw anything. Three reasons:

- Recording stopped as soon as you opened a file. Blender drops an add-on's handlers on every file load, and Hindsight's recorder wasn't marked to survive that. No stroke was recorded, so the slider never appeared.
- In Sculpt Mode on Blender 4.3 and newer, the slider was drawn under the brush shelf.
- Before the first recorded stroke there was nothing on screen at all, and the sidebar tab is hidden until you press N.

## What's fixed and new

- The recorder survives file loads and puts itself back if anything removes it.
- The slider sits above the brush shelf, and shows up empty in Sculpt and Vertex Paint Mode before your first stroke.
- The Undo History tab (press N) was rebuilt from standard Blender widgets, with a real slider, back and forward buttons and a status line. The same controls are in a header button, and F3 finds the main actions.
- Run self-check and Copy diagnostics, for bug reports.
- History files have a format version and a checksum per step. Damaged steps are never applied, and files from a newer Hindsight are left untouched. Beta 1 files load as they are.
- One stroke is always one step: quick strokes no longer merge, and slow modifier stacks no longer split them.
- Blender's own undo after a Hindsight jump no longer mixes up the mesh or drops steps.
- Plainer labels and messages throughout.

The full list is in the [changelog](https://min3scon.github.io/Hindsight/changelog/).

## Install

Download `hindsight.zip` below (keep it zipped). In Blender: Edit > Preferences > Get Extensions, the arrow at the top right, Install from Disk. Then press N in the 3D Viewport and open Undo History.

Found a bug? Open the Help panel in the Undo History tab, click Copy diagnostics, and [file a report](https://github.com/Min3scon/Hindsight/issues/new/choose).
